import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',p); task=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(task)

def synth(h,w,rows,cols,sep,base,marks):
    g=[[base]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(w): g[r][c]=sep
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h): g[r][c]=sep
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        for j,c in enumerate(cols):
            g[r][c]=marks[i][j]
    return g
# Demo 1 compressed source boundary values

import re
usertexts=['\n'.join(c.get('text','') for c in m.get('content',[]) if c.get('type')=='text') for m in msgs if m.get('role')=='user']
demo_pairs=[]
for tx in usertexts:
 for m in re.finditer(r'Demo pair (\d+) input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \1 output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance|\Z)',tx,re.S):
  n=int(m.group(1)); dims=(int(m.group(2)),int(m.group(3))); rawin=m.group(4); outdims=(int(m.group(5)),int(m.group(6))); rawout=m.group(7)
  gi=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in rawin.splitlines() if line.strip()]
  go=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in rawout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
  demo_pairs.append((n,gi,go,dims,outdims))
print([(n,len(g),len(g[0]),len(o),len(o[0])) for n,g,o,_,_ in demo_pairs])
